tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I haven't paid anything yet. You asked me to pay Granite Facilities's approved invoice, but two of their invoices are approved:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-71145 | $4,663.45 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-16359 | $1,981.66 | 2026-11-25 | approved |

Their other invoices don't need paying: INV-44675 is already paid, and INV-69312 is a draft still waiting for approval. No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

Which should I pay: INV-71145 (the earlier due date), INV-16359, or both? Both are under the $10,000 limit, so neither needs controller approval. Once you tell me, I'll pay by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available), make sure each one goes out only once, and send you the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-16359, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-16359, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-16359 by wire from the operating account. It went out once, with no duplicates.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-16359, Granite Facilities (V-280)
- **Amount:** $1,981.66 (the full invoice amount)
- **Method:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent

The operating account's payment list shows only this one payment. It was under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. As you asked, I didn't pay INV-71145 ($4,663.45) because it's under dispute, and it's still marked approved.
